verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software platform with an API. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no API surface (the OpenAPI probes return 404) and nothing suggesting the firm ships the capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
